name: player_compute_turn_slip_delta
description: Player::ComputeTurnSlipDelta transforms projectile velocity into local space, clamps forward/lateral axes, applies bank/turn dynamics, and stops slip SFX on lateral zero-crossing.
known_limits: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?ComputeTurnSlipDelta@Player@@YIXPAUzUtil_SaveGameState@@@Z at 0x429d30 currently fails with 458 unmasked mismatches after masking 24 relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 401 bytes, the VC object symbol is 496 bytes, and the triage artifact is build/vc5-verify/player_compute_turn_slip_delta/verify/429d30_byte_triage.txt.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x429d30 copies projectileSpawnVel to localVel, transforms it through motionBasis, clamps localVel.z with axisClampRuntime, applies UpdateBankAndTurnDynamics over g_Player_DeltaTime to localVel.x, calls StopSlipSfx when lateral velocity crosses zero, and clamps localVel.x with axisClampRuntime.
The native smoke verifies forward clamp and lateral zero-cross slip SFX stop behavior.
